note: Stage 5 step 2: converter line (PLAN Part 5B). Values not given by PLAN are fixed here before any converter result is seen and are recorded in every run.

groups.fixed_label_coding: source-visit label; MCI is coded 0 (not yet AD), as in the inclusive manifests

dose.onset_window: tau_i = a_i + (b_i - a_i) sigmoid(theta_i), [a_i, b_i] = last visit before the first AD label and that first AD visit
dose.mci_partial_dose: exploratory variant only: CN->MCI subjects receive kappa_MCI * c_i(tau) on their MCI window, kappa_MCI = sigmoid(k) learned globally

fit.initialization: P3 pooled direct_c4 best.pt of the same representation and seed (trained on stable subjects only)
fit.training_subjects: view train split: stable subjects keep constant conditions; train converters get a learned onset
fit.objective: direct_c4 recipe losses and ramps (fully ramped: training continues from a trained cocycle), condition = per-leg average dose; group-rate and disease-gap leaves use stable subjects only; plus lambda * mean(theta^2)

c1.heads: fine-tuned at head_learning_rate_multiplier x recipe lr

selection.rule: macro over {CN-stable, AD-stable, converters} of the first-to-last decoded-shape ratio to no-change + 0.2 x all-pair shape ratio; val converters use their oracle-window midpoint onset (validation labels only)
selection.stable_non_inferiority: test error on stable subjects within 1% of the P3 cocycle (gate G5.7)

test_onset.prefix_only: if the observed prefix already contains the post-conversion label, tau = midpoint of the prefix window; otherwise the current label is kept (constant condition)
test_onset.oracle_window: window from all visits, tau at its midpoint; reported separately as an upper bound

comparators.c0: P3 pooled direct_c4 checkpoint, source-visit label
comparators.brainode_core: P3 pooled brainode checkpoint, source-visit label
comparators.brainode_full: PCA only: P3 pooled BrainODE-core field with the condition re-estimated from the predicted shape at every RK4 substep by a voxel 3-D CNN (task3 brainode_cognition), trained on stable train shapes plus pseudo-cognitive samples

brainode_full.pseudo_sampling: pairs of a CN-stable and an AD-stable train visit of similar age (|age difference| <= 5 y); code z = (1 - alpha) z_CN + alpha z_AD, alpha ~ U(0, 1), target c = alpha
brainode_full.estimator: task3 VoxelCognitionCNN settings, BCE on observed labels plus soft pseudo targets (the two terms averaged), temperature fitted on validation
brainode_full.estimator_input: solid voxelizations of decoded PCA-128 shapes (the shapes the estimator sees during feedback), never raw meshes

synthetic_recovery.baselines: first visits of CN-stable subjects in the view's val split (the test split stays sealed)
synthetic_recovery.schedules: visit times and conversion windows of real train converters (CN->AD and MCI->AD)
synthetic_recovery.noise: Gaussian per code coordinate with the RMS residual of C0 on stable val first-to-last pairs
